name: Bloodmage: Uncanny Movement raises Agility, all three hit ratings and Claw Sweep threat (#1792)
contract: Uncanny Movement 301064: "Level 20 Passive. Increases your Agility by $s1% and your hit rating by $s2% of your Agility. In addition, Claw Sweep now generates additional threat." Effect 0 is aura 137 SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE with MiscValue 1 = STAT_AGILITY, amount 25. Effect 1 is aura 220 SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT, amount 5, MiscValue 224 = bits 5, 6 and 7 = CR_HIT_MELEE, CR_HIT_RANGED and CR_HIT_SPELL (Unit.h:223-225), MiscValueB 1 = STAT_AGILITY, consumed in Player::UpdateRating (PlayerUpdates.cpp:659-661) as CalculatePct(GetStat(MiscValueB), GetAmount()) for every rating whose bit is set - so all three hit ratings must move, which is the point of MiscValue 224. Effect 2 is aura 108 with MiscValue 2 = SPELLMOD_THREAT, amount 50, EffectSpellClassMask [0, 0, 16384], which over SpellFamilyName 26 selects exactly the eight Claw Sweep ranks (500169 and 500436-500444) and nothing else; SPELLMOD_THREAT is applied at ThreatManager.cpp:709, so the assertion reads the modifier rather than damage, which SPELLMOD_THREAT never changes. The rating gains are 5% of the post-buff Agility, which is well above 3 at level 80. No source or SQL change is involved.
